definitions.explanation: A compensation system where pay is calculated based on individual performance, sales results, or output rather than a fixed salary. Common in sales and real estate.

examples.japanese: {歩合給|ぶあいきゅう}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{働|はたら}く→働く：00503_hataraku⟧。
⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{仕事|しごと}→仕事：00480_shigoto⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{基本給|きほんきゅう}→基本給：21335_kihonkyuu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{歩合給|ぶあいきゅう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{加|くわ}わる→加わる：01940_kuwawaru⟧。
examples.english: This job has a base salary plus commission.

examples.japanese: {歩合給|ぶあいきゅう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{割合|わりあい}→割合：01760_wariai⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{高|たか}い→高い：00500_takai⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧で、⟦{売|う}れない→売れる：02012_ureru⟧⟦{月|つき}→月：02230_tsuki⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{収入|しゅうにゅう}→収入：03213_shuunyuu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{大|おお}きく→大きい：00335_ookii⟧⟦{下|さ}がる→下がる：01188_sagaru⟧。
examples.english: Since the commission rate is high, income drops significantly in months with low sales.

notes:
Composed of ⟦{歩合|ぶあい}→歩合：17561_buai⟧ (percentage, commission rate) and {給|きゅう} (salary, pay). A business/employment term for compensation tied to performance.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {歩合給|ぶあいきゅう}{制|せい}: commission-based pay system
- {歩合給|ぶあいきゅう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{割合|わりあい}→割合：01760_wariai⟧: commission rate
- ⟦{基本給|きほんきゅう}→基本給：21335_kihonkyuu⟧＋{歩合給|ぶあいきゅう}: base salary plus commission
- {完全|かんぜん}{歩合給|ぶあいきゅう}: fully commission-based pay (no base salary)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{固定給|こていきゅう}→固定給：18879_koteikyuu⟧: fixed salary — pay that does not change based on performance
- {成果給|せいかきゅう}: performance-based pay — similar concept, broader term
- {出来高|できだか}⟦{払|ばら}い→払い：09655_barai⟧: piecework pay — payment based on the quantity produced

USAGE:
In Japanese job listings, the terms {歩合給|ぶあいきゅう}{制|せい} or ⟦{歩合|ぶあい}{制|せい}→歩合制：08089_buaisei⟧ indicate that all or part of the compensation depends on performance. The term {完全|かんぜん}{歩合給|ぶあいきゅう} (fully commission-based) means there is no guaranteed base salary.
